title: Verification to get Trust, to create Abstraction - the journey from Self Driving Cars to AILANG World LBAC
description: Abstraction rises as we trust, and trust rises with verification. The same journey that took cars from hand cranks to autonomous passengers is now happening to programming — and AILANG World is a bet on Language-Based Agent Control as the verification layer.

1: A weathered Land Rover Series parked in woodland, the kind of car whose mechanics a driver was expected to understand and repair
2: The AILANG mark: a white lambda symbol on a dark hexagon with an orange border
3: Two parallel journeys: Land Rover to assisted driving to autonomous passenger, and low-level languages to frameworks to an AI-operated environment. Each leap is gated by verification, resting on an AILANG World foundation of typed goals, scoped capabilities, budgets, declared effects, evidence and immutable history
